headline: EPS swings to a profit, up sequentially
summary_short: H.U. Group Holdings reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ¥28.46, up 28.8% q/q from ¥22.09, swinging from a ¥21.08 per-share loss a year earlier.
summary_long: EPS of ¥28.46 rose 28.8% sequentially from ¥22.09 and swung from a ¥21.08 per-share loss in the year-ago quarter. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
